newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine overnight money rises to 12.40625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine overnight money rises to 12.40625 pct.

text.p: The Philippine call loan rate rose higher to 12.40625 percent from Monday's 11.78125 percent as liquidity remained tight, traders said.
They said most of the banks had parked their excess funds in termed reverse repos and dollars where yields are higher.
One trader said the situation worsened when the auction committee awarded higher volume in last Monday's Treasury bill auction than those which would mature tomorrow.
